display_long_description:
Take the helm of an armed superyacht and fight your way through twelve missions on open water.

This is not a thumbstick game. You reach out, close your fist around the actual wheel of the boat,
and turn it — and the hull answers. Your other hand finds the throttle lever, pushes it to the stop,
and you feel the bow lift. The bow minigun tracks wherever you look, so you line up an enemy boat
with your eyes and squeeze the trigger. Missiles are one press away.

TWELVE MISSIONS, IN ORDER
Learn the helm on a run between three buoys, then hunt your first target, launch off a ramp at full
throttle, race a clock through a buoy course, level a building with missiles, hold out for ninety
seconds under fire from four boats, and finish as the last hull standing against eight. Every mission
is scored on time, awards up to three stars, and remembers your best run. Progress is saved on your
headset — no account, no sign-in.

BUILT FOR THE HEADSET
The game asks the display for 120 Hz and holds it, with fixed foveated rendering and a frame-time
guard that protects the refresh rate rather than an average. The sea is a custom shader: six octaves
of analytic swell, real sun glitter, and your own hull's shadow across it. Seated play throughout,
with an adjustable comfort vignette and quality presets in the settings.

SIX LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian, switchable at any time.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR HEADSET
No account, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking. T
